name: Camping Sunnawirt
beschreibung: The Camping Sunnawirt is located in the municipality of Heiterwang in Außerfern. The site is surrounded by meadows and forests. It offers pitches for holidaymakers seeking peace and quiet. The sanitary facilities are clean and well maintained. Nearby is the Plansee, which invites swimming and sailing. Hikes in the surrounding mountains are possible, as are bike tours. In winter, the Zugspitze and Berwang ski areas are easily accessible.
